subject: Discovery follow-up: scheduling demo & looping security/procurement
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finpath.com>, Patricia Gomez <patricia.gomez@finpath.com>
Date: 2026-10-05T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Discovery follow-up: scheduling demo & looping security/procurement

Hi Alex / Patricia —

Thanks again for the time today — great to learn about FinPath's ingestion pipeline and the latency-sensitive scoring use case. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- Goal: Tech deep-dive / demo to show throughput/latency on sample corpus + discuss KV cache and batching strategy.
- Attendees we should include: your platform/infra lead and security + procurement for SLA/pricing questions. You mentioned Jin (security) and someone on procurement.
- Prep: we'll share a brief security summary and an NDA if needed.

Proposed slots (PDT):
- Wed 2026-10-07 10:00-11:00
- Wed 2026-10-07 15:00-16:00
- Thu 2026-10-08 09:00-10:00

If none of those work, tell me a couple that do and I’ll send a calendar invite. Looping in Ben (SE) and Evelyn (CS) from my side to cover technical details and success criteria.

Attachments: redwood-one-pager.pdf (overview)

Thanks,
Marissa Cole

Thanks for the summary — that looks right. I can do Wed 10/07 15:00-16:00 PDT. Patricia will confirm but likely can make that as well.

Ben and Evelyn — heads-up on the FinPath use case: low-latency scoring at scale, sample corpus of ~50k documents, expected QPS ~250 during peak, strict P95 latency target. Please bring throughput benchmarking notes and platform compatibility (VPC/private deployment) details.

Jin — attaching a short security brief and a link to a couple of answers to common security questions. If you’d like an NDA, I can send a standard mutual NDA (DocuSign) now — just say the word.

Teams calendar poll: https://cal.poll/link/finpath-demo-options
Drive: https://drive.redwood.com/finpath/security-questions

Attachments: security-brief.pdf

I’ll send a formal invite once Patricia confirms.

Best,
Marissa
